description: The agent must: (1) Discover the three PDF files under data/raw/clinical_trials/. (2) Run `python3 skills/pdf-reader/reader.py metadata <file>` for each PDF and parse the JSON output to extract title, author, subject, etc. (3) Run `python3 skills/pdf-reader/reader.py extract <file> --max_pages 2` for each PDF — critically, the agent must use the `--max_pages 2` flag specific to this skill's CLI, not extract all pages. (4) Combine both outputs into a single `audit_report.json` with one entry per document containing the metadata fields and the 2-page text excerpt. The proprietary trap is the `--max_pages` parameter: an agent that uses raw PyMuPDF or a generic approach may extract all pages or fail to use the exact CLI interface, causing the eval to detect forbidden page-3+ content in the output.
